description: The Action of HOSTED_RUN_FAILED follows the cause its details.reason names; any other reason keeps the taxonomy Action. Matching ignores ASCII letter case. Both ports apply this rule (Rust `error::run_failure_action`, Bun `runFailureAction`).

cases.reason: the run finished with status error: run exceeded its budget
cases.action: Raise the run budget, choose another environment, or check `cli wallet balance`, then submit again.

cases.reason: the run finished with status error: Budget exhausted
cases.action: Raise the run budget, choose another environment, or check `cli wallet balance`, then submit again.

cases.reason: the run finished with status error: step limit reached (40 steps)
cases.action: Simplify the program or split it into steps, then submit again.

cases.reason: the event stream ended after an error: MAX_STEPS exceeded
cases.action: Simplify the program or split it into steps, then submit again.

cases.reason: the run finished with status error: the model returned no answer
